## Positions

- **Director of Research**, International Growth Centre — present
- **Research Fellow in Environmental Economics**, London School of Economics — present
- **Consultant**, World Bank — 2024
- **Policy Economist**, International Growth Centre (Bangladesh, Myanmar, Pakistan, Afghanistan) — 2017–2018
- **Country Economist**, International Growth Centre, Myanmar

## Education

- **PhD, Economics** — London School of Economics

## Research Interests

Environmental economics, development economics, and political economy —
including energy access and electrification, climate change and poverty,
natural disasters, political accountability, mass media, deforestation,
land use, and industrial policy.
